summary: Iteration 2 backend + frontend testing for GateFlow QR pickup scan + Twilio-simulated WhatsApp fallback. Added 9 new pytest cases (TestWhatsAppStatus, TestScanPickup) on top of the existing iteration-1 suite. All 29 backend tests pass. Playwright E2E covered: learner register → guard mark arrived → OTP+QR SVG rendered on learner card, WhatsApp drawer subtitle 'WhatsApp Business (simulated)', guard invalid QR (error toast, dialog stays open), guard valid QR (dialog closes, delivery picked_up, capacity decrements), 'Handed over' notification reaches learner. Room capacity restored to 40. No Twilio creds set (as requested).

design_issues.screen: All shadcn Dialogs (arrive, pickup, walkin, qr-scan)
issues: React a11y warning: 'Missing Description or aria-describedby for DialogContent' on every dialog open. Non-blocking but should add a DialogDescription/sr-only description for a11y compliance.

action_items: Optional: add DialogDescription (or aria-describedby) to all shadcn DialogContent components to silence React a11y warnings.
critical_code_review_comments: QrScanDialog manages the html5-qrcode lifecycle only via `open` prop but the useEffect cleanup catches errors silently — safe here; keep in mind that a rejected stop() on some browsers would swallow warnings.

scan_pickup returns 400 for the 'already picked_up' case via the shared complete_pickup helper (message 'Delivery is not awaiting pickup') — matches spec but the error surfaces to the guard as a generic toast; consider more specific copy for repeated scans.
GuardDashboard polls every 8s; UI shows the newly arrived OTP+QR only after next poll (up to 8s lag). Acceptable but could be pushed via WebSocket in the future.
seed_data_creation: Created 2 test deliveries during E2E (TEST_UI_QR_01, TEST_UI_QR_02); both completed to picked_up and left in history (as designed). No orphaned arrived/expected rows.
test_credentials: Guard guard@rishihood.edu.in/guard123, Learner aarav@rishihood.edu.in/learner123, Admin admin@rishihood.edu.in/admin123 — all confirmed working via /api/auth/login.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Regression suite at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py now covers iteration 1 (auth, roles, delivery flow, walk-in, capacity, stats, notifications) and iteration 2 (WhatsApp simulated status/channel, QR pickup scan happy/invalid/wrong-otp/forbidden/already-picked_up + manual OTP regression). Twilio env vars are intentionally empty — /api/whatsapp/status returns {configured:false} and notifications carry channel='simulated'. Room capacity must stay at 40 after any test (the capacity_full test restores it in a finally block). Camera is unavailable in headless Chromium so QR is tested via qr-manual-input path.
rca_of_the_issue: N/A — no failures. Only cosmetic a11y warning noted.
